Gives how long a movie is, in seconds. The length is what the file says; some formats (MPEG programs) only estimate it from their bit rate, and once the movie has been decoded to its end the time of its last picture is used if that is longer. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals do not tell how long a movie is.

```blitzbasic
movie = OpenMovie("intro.mpg")
Print "The intro takes " + MovieLength(movie) + " seconds."
```
@param movie  A movie handle from [OpenMovie](OpenMovie).
@returns The length in seconds, or 0 if the movie is not open or its file does not say.
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the movie does not exist, for example the 0 of a movie that failed to open, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
